steps_to_reproduce: Open the MTS CI Admin Console.
Go to the Admin section.
Search for the bookmaker in the dropdown menu.
Set maximum payout to 50 EUR.
Place a bet whose potential payout is higher than 50 EUR + stake.
Verify the ticket is rejected with -511.
fix_suggestions: Punter/ticket: Lower stake or remove selections until potential payout is within the max payout limit.
Operator/MTS: Raise maximum payout for the limit ID in MTS CI Admin Console if the limit is too restrictive.
Client integration: Map -511 to a clear user-facing message instead of exposing raw MTS text.
Client integration: Support alt-stake reoffer if MTS returns one (resubmit with ref.type: alt-stake).
Client integration: Capture a frontend screenshot of the displayed rejection message for E2E sign-off.

steps_to_reproduce: Configure bookmaker: Max liability = 10, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 1.
Configure sub bookmaker (limit ID): Max liability = 100000, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 0.1.
Place a bet on an event you have never placed a bet on before.
Ensure the bet payout is higher than 10 EUR + stake.
Verify the ticket is rejected with -701.
fix_suggestions: Punter/ticket: Reduce stake or liability (lower odds or fewer legs) so total liability stays under the bookmaker cap.
Operator/MTS: Increase bookmaker max liability or adjust bet factor at bookmaker or sub-bookmaker level.
Client integration: Show a customized liability-limit message to discourage repeated rejected submissions.

variants.message: Liability EUR XXX is over Bet liability limit EUR YYY on Limit ID(Bookmaker or Global) level, Selection: `<SelectionURL>`, Match: `<Match ID>`

steps_to_reproduce: Prerequisite: Punter CCF must be set to 1 or higher.
Configure bookmaker: Max liability = 100, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 0.1.
Configure sub bookmaker (limit ID): Max liability = 30000, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 1.
Place a bet on an event you have never placed a bet on before (first ticket should be accepted).
Submit a second bet on the same event.
Verify the second ticket is rejected with -702 when the bet liability limit is breached.
fix_suggestions: Punter/ticket: Reduce stake so single-bet liability stays within the bookmaker bet liability cap.
Operator/MTS: Raise bookmaker max liability or bet factor, or review sub-bookmaker overrides.
Client integration: Explain that the per-bet limit was hit, not total exposure.
Client integration: Offer alt-stake reoffer if returned by MTS.

variants.message: Liability EUR XXX is over Total liability limit EUR YYY on Customer level, Selection: lcoo:10/1/*/1, Match: 11901644

steps_to_reproduce: Prerequisite: Punter CCF must be <= 1.01.
Configure bookmaker: Max liability = 30000, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 0.1.
Configure sub bookmaker (limit ID): Max liability = 100, Bet factor (Pre-Match and Live) = 0.1.
Place a small-stake bet on an event you have never placed a bet on before (should be accepted).
Keep placing bets on the same event, gradually increasing stake, until rejected with -703.
fix_suggestions: Punter/ticket: Lower stake or stop placing additional bets on the same selection/event until exposure drops.
Operator/MTS: Review punter CCF and customer-level liability settings; adjust if warranted.
Client integration: Use messaging that signals a personal limit was reached rather than a generic error.
Client integration: Surface guidance to try a lower stake instead of raw liability figures.
